notes.text: The goal is 20 wins, each in a different race.
There are 40 distinct races to pick from, so only half need a win.
Winning the same race twice adds nothing to the count.
Land, water and air races all qualify.

notes.text: Cal is met in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Afterwards he texts a purple fishing marker; PowerPyx places it west of Key Lento.
The trophy pops when you out-fish Cal in his challenge.

notes.text: Three games run on the home TV: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind.
A fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits in arcade cabinets around the map.
Beating every level of any single one of them is enough.

versions.text: Any of the four, including the three on the home TV.
Describes it as finishing a game on an arcade machine.

differs.call: Home TV games count; GTABase and PowerPyx name them explicitly.

notes.text: Andy only works with Lucia and reaches out during Chapter 3.
His strand has five parts; the fifth, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy.
The strand stays open after the story ends.
It is a hidden trophy.

notes.text: Kenton runs out of Key Lento and first hires Jason in Chapter 1.
The job is recovering treasure from seven shipwrecks with diving and a metal detector.
He drops out after Chapter 1 and comes back later in the story.
It is a hidden trophy tied to his last mission.

notes.text: Billy hands out work at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break (Chapter 2) is done.
Five jobs in all; Hometown Heroes is the one that unlocks it.
The trophy is tied to Billy's final mission.

notes.text: Eight qualifying stranger strands are needed, and not every strand qualifies.
Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count.
The full list is still unknown, so watch the trophy's progress counter.

notes.text: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gives you the key cloner (Clonin' Keys).
Deliver all 16 listed sports cars to his garage.
WAiNK tells you whether a car is on the list; Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotel driveways are good hunting spots.
PowerPyx says most of the listed cars turn up in east Vice City.

notes.text: Only Jason can take Tyrone's jobs, which open after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy enough synthetic drug labs around Vice City to unlock his follow-up job.
That follow-up (Shut Down the Labs per GTABase) awards the trophy.

notes.text: The counter must reach 18; a spot done by both Jason and Lucia counts twice.
The last spot needs both characters, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Take Lucia's meditation at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth; it is gone once Chapter 1 ends.
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from Chapter 1.

versions.text: Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 session vanishes, but nobody has confirmed the trophy needs it.
Missable: the Chapter 1 meditation is locked for good after that chapter.
No missable trophies confirmed at all.

differs.call: Treat it as missable and do the Chapter 1 meditation.

notes.text: Bret's hunting jobs open for Jason after Chapter 2, starting in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks; all 15 decks are needed for 100% anyway.
Which animal actually triggers the trophy is not yet confirmed.
A clean one-shot kill pays better but is optional.

The Collections page of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.

notes.text: Scan 100 different spots with the WAiNK app.
Any mix works: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher tags.
Those three categories add up to 89, so some No Flusher tags are required.

versions.text: Scanning locations with the WAiNK phone app.

100% completion asks for 70 of them, so this comes on the way.
Progress > Challenges lists what is done; many clear during normal play, so leave it for late.

notes.text: Doable once Jason and Lucia team up after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Reach four stars together, then slip out of the red search area.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route.
Chapter 4 bank vault robberies hand out four stars, so it can come naturally.

notes.text: With your partner along, hit three shops in a row without the wanted level ever clearing.
Choose shops close together; the three north Vice City jewelry stores fit.
The unlock can lag after the third robbery; a fourth shop fixes it.

100% asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so this unlocks along the way.

notes.text: Five kills must land inside one Combat Focus activation; fill the meter first.
Gang members at illegal operations count; police, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not.
An assault rifle and Focus upgrades make it easier; it often pops without trying.

notes.text: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge; planes out on the airfield do not count.
Gates E3 and E4 are the suggested ones.
Take off and get about 1 km from the airport; the pop can be delayed.
